title: The Mouse and the Bull
summary: A tiny mouse bit a giant bull on the ankle and scurried into a narrow crack in the stable wall....
full_text:
A tiny mouse bit a giant bull on the ankle and scurried into a narrow crack in the stable wall.

The enraged bull pawed the earth, lowered his massive horns, and charged, smashing his forehead against the stone wall until he collapsed, bruised and exhausted.

The little mouse poked his head out, squeaking merrily: "Mighty size is not everything; sometimes the small triumph without breaking a bone!"
moral: The small and nimble often outlast the towering fury of the mighty.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Mouse and the Bull"?
options: Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
